title: WARRANT project config
description: `.warrant/warrant.json` — the single configuration point of a WARRANT project (08 section 3).

kernel.description: Kernel compatibility line as `major.minor`, for example `0.1`.

openspec.description: Accepted OpenSpec version range, for example `1.13.x`.

packs.description: Packs enabled in this project, keyed by pack id.

^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: Version range and parameters for one pack.

version.description: Accepted version range of the pack.

params.description: Pack parameters validated by the pack's own `params_schema`.

defaults.description: Project-wide values used where a pack object leaves them unset.

check_timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for a check without `execution.timeout_s`; when absent the kernel uses 1800 (ADR-0017).

paths.description: Project paths WARRANT needs to know about.

tests.description: Root directory of the project test suite.

src.description: Root directory of the project sources.

roles.description: Role name to the list of logins that may act in that role.

identities.description: Non-human identities acting in this project (ADR-0010).

agents.description: Agents allowed to act on behalf of the project.

login.description: Login or account name of the agent.

kind.description: Kind of the identity, for example `bot` or `service-account`.

description.description: Free-form note about what this identity is used for.

trusted_signers.description: Key identifiers whose signatures are accepted as attestation (ADR-0010).

frontends.description: Frontends `warrant sync` generates files for (ADR-0034 point 1); when absent no frontend file is touched.
